purpose: Non-admission research discovery of differentiated original national European building register, footprint, INSPIRE service and viewer products for a 51-country coverage audit. These metadata leads do not admit data for commercial CAT model use.

entries.name: Poland GUGiK EGiB official building geometries national GeoParquet / county GPKG
entries.provider: Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography Poland (GUGiK)
entries.spatial_scope: Poland; nationwide aggregate of registered county cadastral WFS services
entries.temporal_scope: New download offer announced 2026-02-04; federated WFS announced 2026-07-16; original asset release dates vary by county
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Country and voivodeship GeoParquet, voivodeship and county GeoPackage, federated county WFS for EGiB building geometry
entries.note: EGiB cadastral building feature products are DISTINCT from the already catalogued BDOT10k generalized topographic buildings and 3D models. WFS is federated across county services and may have incomplete local availability. Neither geometry nor EGiB ID is evidence of actual policyholder, occupancy, construction quality or TIV. Freeze county/voivodeship release, CRS, IDs and official file conditions.

Distinct from Slovakia WMTS base maps. Validate full national geometry/count, building vs building-part identifiers, height availability, and exact source attribution before adoption.

Building geometries derive from cadastral maps and are not independent of the same official cadastre and EUBUCCO government input. Check WFS paging, GML schema, rights and cadastral completeness.

entries.name: Finland Ryhti completed building records and building INSPIRE OGC API
entries.provider: Finnish Environment Institute (SYKE) / Ryhti built environment system

entries.resolution_or_granularity: Open completed-building CSV/JSON .gz packages updated daily plus OGC API Features and INSPIRE BU building WMS
entries.note: New national building-record feed is distinct from the existing National Land Survey Finland topographic INSPIRE buildings. Official package URLs include open_building.csv.gz and open_building.json.gz. Verify building ID join, completion status, geocodes, area/height fields, live coverage, source update date and legal open licence for downstream insurer modelling.

entries.name: Iceland official IS 50V buildings national vector base map layer

entries.note: IS50V is a generalized cartographic buildings layer not a complete cadastral inventory of every annex, unit or insurable asset. Confirm actual building polygon/point classes, edition, source licence and scale-related omissions. Distinct from private commercial Iceland addresses and EUBUCCO (which does not cover Iceland).

entries.name: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys INSPIRE buildings dataset

entries.name: Portugal Base Geográfica de Edifícios (BGE) official building geographic base

entries.note: Distinct from DGT cadastral *parcels* and the Portuguese address/census building records. A cadastral parcel is NOT a building polygon and its market value is not TIV. Check exact building class, regional coverage including Madeira/Azores and file format before admission.

entries.note: The web catalogue describes a Buildings product but not automatically a freely redistributable national GeoPackage. Confirm map vs download, precise building feature schema, rights and INSPIRE transformations. This is not the same as Hungarian parcels or address registry.

entries.name: Liechtenstein official Building and Dwelling Register public data

entries.temporal_scope: Public register current; exact time range and extract refresh need review

entries.note: A dwelling or address record does not necessarily correspond to one footprint; field-level public availability and Geocat coverage must be verified. Liechtenstein is NOT in EUBUCCO EU27+UK+NO+CH, and Swiss building registers cannot be treated as Liechtenstein coverage.

entries.name: Andorra historic building situation polygon inventory (1995 imagery)

entries.note: Strong historical reference, NOT a modern nationwide active-structure census. Source explicitly based on 1995 imagery; buildings may have changed drastically. Review datum NTF/Lambert Zone III, 1:5000 generalization and exact archive licence before use. Never map 'construction/ruin' to current insurable asset.
